intro: Interlock and The Gentlemen feature among eight Cisco-tagged articles published between 16 April and 10 September 2026. Three CVEs carry a maximum CVSS score of 10: CVE-2026-20079, CVE-2026-20127, and CVE-2026-20182. CVE-2022-20653 and CVE-2024-20401 also appear. Coverage spans enterprise networking, telecommunications, the federal civilian executive branch, government, and service providers, with five critical and two high-severity items recorded. Reporting reaches Global, North america, Turkey, the UK, and the United states.
